research_question: Does TRAIN-only PSX return evidence support a reproducible hard cluster or soft relationship structure for downstream hierarchical decision-making?

universe.survivorship_limitation: Current authoritative common-equity membership is associated with historical returns; this is not a point-in-time historical universe.

temporal_protocol.name: phase1_common_frozen_relationship_window_v1
temporal_protocol.rl_partition_distinction: rl_partition_v1 instead splits each symbol's own usable chronological observations 70/15/15; its dates are symbol-specific and do not define this common clustering window.

source_provenance.closure_rerun_note: The consolidated file gained post-2026-08-20 observations after the original audits. Predicate-pushed fixed-TRAIN reruns reproduced the later hard-audit counts and metrics, showing the frozen TRAIN slice remains logically consistent.
source_provenance.sector_scope: Current sector labels; not historical effective-dated membership. Post-hoc except for the bounded sector-informed multiview audit.

experiments.name: Raw return-correlation methodology diagnostics
experiments.configuration: Embedded versioned constants: log/Pearson primary, angular-chord distance, average hierarchical clustering, overlap and K sweeps.
experiments.data_partition: TRAIN-only; original code derived a common 70/15/15 calendar boundary from the then-current dataset.

experiments.name: Hard clustering protocol selection
experiments.configuration: Overlap floors 120/252/504; average, complete, and positive-correlation graph protocols; K=8..20; Pareto evidence table.
experiments.data_partition: TRAIN-only common calendar with separately refitted TRAIN subwindows.

experiments.name: Market-mode removal and correlation-noise audit
experiments.configuration: Raw and static equal-weight market-residual Pearson correlation; bounded shrinkage feasibility; complete linkage; K=8..20; K=15 robustness reference.

experiments.name: Sector-informed multiview clustering
experiments.configuration: Return distance plus categorical current-sector distance at lambda 0.0/0.1/0.2/0.3; K=8..20; lambda=0.1, K=12 bounded robustness reference.
experiments.universe: 508 identities; 318 fixed complete core; 298 temporal common core

experiments.name: NMF soft relationship representation
experiments.configuration: K=8/10/12/15/20/25/30; deterministic NNDSVDA NMF; separately fitted temporal windows; simple/Pearson and log/Spearman robustness; nonnegative capital-conserving decoder.
experiments.data_partition: Explicit frozen common TRAIN interval 2016-07-26..2023-08-03; sectors post-hoc only.
experiments.universe: 508 identities; 318 direct fit; 301 temporal core; unsupported identities explicit

hard_clustering_acceptance_policy.decision_rule: A candidate must be materially defensible across temporal stability, return cohesion/separation, balance, and representation robustness without merely reproducing current sectors. The original protocol intentionally used a Pareto evidence table and did not predeclare a scalar score or numeric silhouette/ARI acceptance floor.

hard_clustering_evidence.strongest_bounded_candidate: sector-informed raw-return complete-linkage, lambda=0.1, K=12 (robustness reference only)
hard_clustering_evidence.market_residualization_effect: Removed the dominant average market correlation and improved cluster-size balance, but reduced return separation and materially worsened temporal/representation stability.
hard_clustering_evidence.sector_weight_effect: Improved combined-distance silhouette, apparent temporal stability, and balance while reducing return cohesion and moving assignments strongly toward static current-sector taxonomy.
hard_clustering_evidence.shrinkage_reason: No strict common return dates across the 318-symbol core; no unsafe imputation was introduced.

soft_relationship_evidence.best_candidate: K=8 (closest to all gates; not accepted)
soft_relationship_evidence.reason: No K passed all predeclared gates. K=8 narrowly missed temporal subspace stability and every full fit failed the convergence requirement; stability weakened as K increased.

final_reason: The bounded hard-clustering families did not jointly provide stable, cohesive, balanced, representation-robust return groups, and the bounded soft NMF family did not satisfy the frozen temporal-stability and convergence gates. Weak or unstable relationship structure is the Phase-1 result.
phase2_inherited_constraint: Phase 2 must not assume reliable discrete clusters or an accepted soft prototype basis. Any later relationship feature must be treated as exploratory and independently justified; the inherited architecture must remain valid without cluster membership.
